title: 2421. Number of Good Paths

examples.explanation: There are 5 good paths consisting of a single node. There is 1 additional good path: 1 -> 0 -> 2 -> 4. (The reverse path 4 -> 2 -> 0 -> 1 is treated as the same as 1 -> 0 -> 2 -> 4.) Note that 0 -> 2 -> 3 is not a good path because vals[2] > vals[0].
There are 5 good paths consisting of a single node. There are 2 additional good paths: 0 -> 1 and 2 -> 3.
The tree consists of only one node, so there is one good path.
